doc.title: Mrs. Mary Lucy Hamill O'Kelly Interview, 1958-05-04

title: Dr. Edmond Souchon's band at parties
summary: Asked about jazz at debutante parties, she recalls Dr. Souchon's string band, which played well at parties, and repeats she never cared for jazz.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, do you remember when they started being played at debutante parties or at balls or anything like that?

Well, no. No. Dr. Sushant, Edmond Sushant had a band, the same other one, a little bit of a chap. They called it Sixth and Seventh-Eight Band. And they played jazz. They played very well. Dr. Sushant was the leader of that, the organizer of that band. And they kept it up. They used to play at different parties. And I think that's about all I know about jazz. I never cared for it, especially when I still don't.
